identity.description: Airtable is a no-code platform for building AI-powered workflows, apps and agents on a relational data layer, with a REST Web API and a hosted MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: Sources are from airtable.com and describe Airtable's developer platform, Web API and MCP server.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code flow with PKCE (code_challenge/code_verifier) and refresh_token grant. The MCP server also supports Dynamic Client Registration.
auth.token_refresh: Access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Refresh tokens are valid for 60 days and are rotated on each use.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes such as data.records:read/write, schema.bases:read/write, data.recordComments:read/write, workspacesAndBases:read. The token must also be granted access to specific bases/workspaces.

access.production_restrictions: The Public API limit is enforced on the Free plan. Organizations may require admins to approve OAuth apps or block MCP/API access. The Enterprise API requires an Enterprise Scale plan.

api.rate_limits: 5 requests per second per base, and 50 requests per second for all traffic using personal access tokens from a user or service account. Exceeding either returns 429, and you must wait 30 seconds.
api.limitations: Free plan has no access to the Views endpoints. Enterprise endpoints require an Enterprise Scale plan.
